pages.title: Your finished-sheet file guide
pages.bodyHtml:
Your uploaded file is the complete production sheet. Prepare and arrange your artwork in your own software before uploading. The app measures and prices it; there is no layout service.

Prepare a ready file

  • Start with a finished PNG at the intended page size, with embedded resolution.
  • Keep the transparent background if that is what you intend to print.
  • The Studio and variant uploaders list additional supported formats. The detailed PNG view accepts PNG only.
  • Review the measured dimensions before checkout, especially when DPI metadata is missing.

Know the limits

This demo explicitly uses a 22.5-inch maximum printable width with 0.02-inch export-rounding tolerance. The 22-inch name on a variant is not the press limit. A genuine overflow is rejected, not squeezed or silently priced.

Variant pricing selects the smallest listed sheet length that covers the finished file. A 22.3 × 78-inch file selects the 22 × 80 variant in this demo. Files longer than every listed length are rejected.

Measured pricing uses server-confirmed billable length at the demo rate of $0.30 per inch. Its maximum length is 240 inches; longer files are rejected, not split. Orientation is selected internally to use the least film that fits. Nobody receives an extra instruction to rearrange your artwork.

Copies are copies

Quantity means complete printed copies of the same sheet. Three copies means the entire file is printed three times. Logos are not nested or combined onto a larger sheet.

Check resolution and the preview

Embedded resolution helps preserve the size you intended. A source with no usable DPI can use the inherited Adobe-resolution or printable-width fallback; do not assume every file is treated as 300 DPI. Check the actual width and length shown by the app.

PNG/JPEG measurements are validated from the stored file header. Large images and other file types may need a server-rendered preview. A missing or invalid file is not orderable just because a preview placeholder appears.

Review demo, not physical fulfillment

The prices here are illustrative and checkout is for test orders. Nothing is physically printed or shipped. The generated product illustrations are not evidence of a material or durability test.

Try the automatic sheet uploader or try measured pricing.

pages.title: Different views. One finished-sheet model.
pages.bodyHtml:
The uploader is the product experience; the blocks below are catalog views linking to real demo products. They do not measure a file or arrange artwork.

Explore automatic variant selection, measured Studio pricing, the PNG detail page, manual sheet selection, and the DTF + UV desk.

Each uploaded file remains a finished sheet. Quantity means copies. Demo catalog prices below refer to complete variant sheets; per-inch products are kept out of these generic catalog cards so the units cannot be confused.

pages.title: Demo support
pages.bodyHtml:
Contact info@actualscope.com for Auto Gang Sheet Upload demo support. Include the file format, measured size, product view, and sheet identity. Do not send payment-card information.

Test orders are not physically printed or shipped.
